narrative: Global equities show mixed signals with US tech outperformance offsetting European weakness. OMX30 sits in structural bull territory (+3.0% vs 200-MA) but technically neutral—RSI at 49.87, MACD below signal, ADX weak at 7.4 indicating low directional conviction. USD/SEK strength at 10.15 favors Swedish exporters, while the 50bp US 10Y yield rise supports bank NIM outlook. Key headwind: weak technicals (MACD negative, Stochastic neutral) and 2.7% distance from 52-week highs signal caution. The Anthropic IPO narrative and geopolitical headlines (Xi/Trump/Putin) add macro volatility overhang.
morningBrief: OMX30 opens constructively with US equity tailwinds and VIX compression creating a risk-on floor. The index holds +3.0% above its 200-MA (structural support ~3080) but struggles near the 50-MA at 3180—a critical test today. Weak ADX (7.4) demands size discipline; treat rallies as selling opportunities until MACD crosses back above signal. Exporters (Volvo B, Atlas Copco A, Ericsson B) get a boost from USD/SEK +0.25%, but watch for reversal if geopolitical headlines escalate. Banks (SEB A, Handelsbanken A) supported by higher US yields. Oil weakness (-1.54%) eases input cost pressure on industrials. Watch for US Jobless Claims at 14:30 CET—a miss could trigger risk-off rerating and test the 3085 lower Bollinger band.
